name: New Technology Acquisition Holdings
summary: New Technology Acquisition Holdings, Inc. (NTAC), which was established in 1986 and has its headquarters in New York, New York, primarily manages large-scale photovoltaic (PV) power facilities and other sustainable energy infrastructure. Its operational scope strategically targets key global regions, including the Americas, Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Additionally, through its network of subsidiaries, the company provides expert services as an engineering, planning, and construction contractor. The firm adopted its current name, New Technology Acquisition Holdings, Inc., in October 2022, having previously been known as Enerkon Solar International, Inc.
